issues.title: Add retry/backoff to the API client

comments.body: heads up: the API client was rewritten in FAFF-88 — the request() pipeline this spec hooks its retry logic into is now client.send(). The retry/backoff work is still wanted, but the spec's design no longer matches the code and needs a refresh before building.

question: Which issue has a spec whose design is now stale — still wanted, but needs a refresh (not cancellation)?
